description: Read EXIF, XMP, IPTC, C2PA, and AI-generation markers from a JPEG, PNG, or WebP. Also reads a PDF info dictionary and XMP, or Word core and app properties. Pass a public file_url or file_base64.

file_base64.description: Base64-encoded file bytes. A data URL is accepted.

file_url.description: Public http or https URL of a JPEG, PNG, WebP, PDF, or DOCX file.

filename.description: Original file name, used in the report.

name: inspect_metadata
